title: Congressional report on the 1944 Maison Rouge meeting

tellings.quote: The US Congress published in June of 1945 before the war in Asia was over. They published a report on basically what was the Maison Rouge meeting that happened in 1944 uh in Straborg.

plain: In June 1945, before the war in Asia was over, the US Congress is said to have published a report on what was basically the Maison Rouge meeting, a 1944 gathering at the Maison Rouge hotel in Strasbourg, France. The writer Peter Levenda, who researches secret history, tells Michels this himself without naming where he read it, and he dates the report to June 1945; he does not say on the show what the report's own words are.
